texts.orig: 7.2.3. Subcontracting during the contract implementation

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Once the contract has entered into force, the successful Tenderer shall retain full_liability_towards ElB for the performance of the contract as a whole. EIB will not have any direct legal commitment with the subcontractor(s) .
